title: Our Wedding
welcome: Join us for a weekend of celebration beneath the plane trees of a Provençal château. We can't wait to share our big day with you.
program_intro: Three days of celebration at the château

travel_modes.title: By plane
travel_modes.desc: Marseille Provence Airport (MRS) is about an hour away by car. Avignon (AVN) and Nîmes (FNI) are smaller alternatives with seasonal flights.

travel_modes.title: By train
travel_modes.desc: Avignon TGV station is 25 minutes from the château, with direct high-speed trains from Paris (2h40). Taxis and rental cars are available at the station.

travel_modes.title: By car
travel_modes.desc: The château sits just off the D99 between Saint-Rémy-de-Provence and Cavaillon. There is plenty of free parking on the grounds.

stay_note: The château itself can only accommodate close family, but there are lovely places nearby. Book early — June is high season in Provence.

stay_options.name: Hôtel du Soleil
stay_options.desc: A friendly hotel with a pool in the centre of Saint-Rémy-de-Provence.

stay_options.name: Mas des Oliviers
stay_options.desc: A charming farmhouse bed & breakfast set among olive groves.

stay_options.name: Auberge de la Fontaine
stay_options.desc: Simple, good-value rooms above a village restaurant.
